title: Wiki Jinja blocked_by is unknown
description:
Live wiki page blocked_issues.md fails render with:

    unknown function: blocked_by is unknown (in <string>:6)

WIKI_GUIDE documents template helpers query, count, issue, children, blocked_by, and blocks. Wiki Jinja currently registers query, count, issue, references, and ai_summarize only.

## Acceptance
- blocked_by(id) returns issues that block the given id (targets of blocked-by dependencies)
- children(id) and blocks(id) are registered as documented
- Rendering blocked_issues.md / equivalent fixture succeeds
- Python and Rust stay in parity

Requested card id kbs-993960.

Feature:
  Scenario: Render blocked issues with blocked_by
    Given a blocked issue depends on a blocker
    When I render blocked_issues.md
    Then the command succeeds and lists the blocker

comments.text:
Implementing documented wiki Jinja helpers on PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/226 (same branch as Markus pipeline; requested card kbs-993960).

blocked_by(id) returns blockers (targets of blocked-by). Also registering children(id) and blocks(id) as WIKI_GUIDE documents them.

Do not merge #226 until this render path is green.
